task_name: World 121 Task A  -  Bank Institution Resemblance Guard, Unmeasured Negative-Bank Disclosure & Card Refund vs. Processor Fee Direction
prompt: Review the Chart of Accounts, cash accounts, bank statement inventory, and corporate card and merchant deposit fee schedules in aether_diagnostics_oct2026_close_sources.xlsx. Evaluate whether institution-name similarity justifies zeroing or remapping any bank account, state the reconciliation and disclosure treatment for any negative book cash account lacking a bank statement, and determine the proper direction and net expense for corporate card fee refunds versus merchant deposit processor fee deductions.

rubric.description: Preserves both First Commercial Bank accounts 1010 ($64,250.00) and 1020 ($14,800.00) for $79,050.00 combined reconciled positive cash.
Refuses to zero or remap 1020 ($14,800.00) as a duplicate bank feed solely from shared institution name because account numbers 8162 and 2473 and account types are distinct.
Computes net 2026-10 book cash across 1010, 1020, and 1030 (-$8,420.50) as $70,629.50 while retaining the -$8,420.50 book balance without an unsupported plug.
Discloses 1030 (-$8,420.50) as an unmeasured bank statement reconciliation item with a 2026-11-30 true-up rather than certifying a verified bank overdraft.
Preserves native Credit=true corporate card annual-fee refund TXN-CC-901 ($695.00) as a credit to 6435 rather than dropping or retiring it as interest.

Sums the 5 merchant deposit processor fee deductions DEP-4401 through DEP-4405 ($182.90, $160.15, $208.60, $144.45, and $149.10) as debits to 6435 totaling $845.20 against $28,570.00 gross deposits ($27,724.80 net cash).
Refuses to flip DEP-4401 through DEP-4405 labeled CREDIT CARD PROC FEE into fee reversals, keeping all 5 lines as positive processor fee charges.
Computes audited 2026-10 net expense in 6435 Bank & Card Fees as $150.20 ($845.20 processor fee charges less $695.00 annual-fee refund credit) with $0.00 reclassification required.
